runtime_status.qualified_status_meaning: scored_unverified_runtime means the unchanged official source emitted and wrapper-validated a real score, but the host environment has not passed the official dependency/CUDA compatibility gate.
strict_b_status_gate: official source revision and source fingerprint match
official-compatible environment passes pip check and the declared CUDA/Torch gate
one real official invocation emits a validated result and its log is preserved

status_meaning.submitted: 已经进入旧 PR 并有真实单视频证据。
status_meaning.prepared_for_pr: 仓库代码和官方运行说明已准备，可以提交官方接入/预检 PR；权重、环境和任务输入由运行者提供。
status_meaning.external_caller_run: 仓库提供字段检查、适配或合并工具；真正评分必须由运行者在官方仓库和官方环境中执行。
status_meaning.runtime_inputs: prompt、首帧、auxiliary_info、真实参考帧和真实集合属于每个实验的输入，不应提交到 Git。
